## What's wrong

A clear description of what happened vs. what should have happened.
(e.g. "Monroe High School's NetSuite address didn't update after WIAA
changed it" or "a departed contact is still active in NetSuite")

## Where

- **School / contact / record affected:**
- **NetSuite record ID (if known):**
- **Sheet tab + row (if known):**

## Evidence

- Link to the relevant GitHub Actions run (Actions tab → workflow run URL)
- Relevant log lines, if you have them
- Screenshot of the sheet or NetSuite record showing the problem

## When did you notice it

Approximate date, and whether this is the first time or recurring.

## Anything you've already tried

e.g. re-ran the manual workflow, checked the sheet, verified the WIAA
source page directly.
